description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkHistoryTimestamp utility in the OpenClawKit project, specifically testing timestamp comparison functions with small tolerances.

classes.name: TalkHistoryTimestampTests
classes.description: A XCTestCase class that tests the functionality of the TalkHistoryTimestamp utility functions.

methods.name: testSecondsTimestampsAreAcceptedWithSmallTolerance
methods.description: Tests that TalkHistoryTimestamp.isAfter correctly recognizes a timestamp slightly less than the threshold as not after, within a small tolerance.

methods.name: testMillisecondsTimestampsAreAcceptedWithSmallTolerance
methods.description: Tests that TalkHistoryTimestamp.isAfter correctly compares millisecond-level timestamps with small differences.
